net_of_cost.caveat: this re-prices the lane's fills after the fact; it is a research restatement of the frictionless book, not a second execution path
net_of_cost.example_fee_floor: 10 bps per side at the base spot tier, before spread, slippage and impact

costs.reading: the book is deliberately frictionless so that the fills can be compared bar by bar with the research restatement; the economic verdict lives in the restatement, not here
costs.where_the_cost_is_charged: ECONOMIC_RESTATEMENT.csv applies the venue cost per round trip and reports 1x/2x/3x; the trade-by-trade PnL stored here is frictionless and must not be read as net

contract.decision_clock: once per closed bar, at data_available_at (the bar's close time)
contract.entry_signal: signal read off bar t fills at the open of bar t+1
contract.exit_signal: signal read off bar t fills at the open of bar t+1, never at bar t's open
contract.intrabar: not resolved here: these rules act on closes only
contract.same_instant_reentry: an entry filling at the same instant as the previous exit is dropped
contract.terminal_mark: an open position at the last closed bar is marked at that close, is_mark=true
contract.undefined_indicator: NaN; every gate that reads it is False

proposal_carries: detail known at the signal bar

portfolio.reading: one budget and one broker book for all three symbols: max_open_positions and both exposure clamps bind across symbols. The WP-EDGE-015 lane's three 10 000 books are a different experiment and their balances are not capital.

protective_exits.residual_optimism: a fill at exactly the stop level is optimistic for a gap through it, and no intrabar ordering between the stop and the target is claimed beyond the policy above
protective_exits.trigger: a resting order: the stop level is tested against the bar's high/low and filled at that level. The order was placed when the entry filled, so it exists before the bar it triggers in — nothing here reads a bar's close to fill inside it

timing_model.fill_convention: next bar open (the instant the signal bar closes)
timing_model.reading: no execution latency is modelled: the fill instant equals the instant the deciding bar became available. A real venue adds queue and network delay, so every fill here is optimistic in timing even though it is no longer causally impossible

weekend_policy.reading: the policy says no weekend trading and this lane honours it; no runtime component reads the flag, so a 7/7 ACTIVE goal needs an explicit risk/governance decision rather than an implicit one — see WEEKEND_POLICY_CONFLICT.md
